text:
Game Network launched on Sky Digital in May 2001, and I think its EPG slot was 215, though I'm recalling this from memory and haven't checked it. The team note limits the answer to 612 or 215. 215 fits better because it sits in the entertainment block where a channel like this would have been placed. 612 looks more like a later slot in the adult or shopping range.

CONFIDENCE: 66
